member.name: M:Microsoft.AspNetCore.StaticWebAssets.Tasks.StaticWebAsset.MaterializeFrameworkAsset(Microsoft.AspNetCore.StaticWebAssets.Tasks.StaticWebAsset,System.String,System.String,System.String,Microsoft.Build.Utilities.TaskLoggingHelper)
member.summary: Materializes a framework asset by copying it to the consuming project's intermediate directory and updating its metadata (Identity, ContentRoot, SourceId, BasePath, SourceType, AssetMode). Used by both the P2P and NuGet package paths. Returns the old identity and old base path so callers can remap endpoints and related assets.

Remaps the Route (and label endpoint property) on an endpoint by stripping the old base path prefix and prepending the new base path. Used when materializing framework assets to update endpoint routes from the library's base path to the consuming project's base path.
